source: X. Li and S. Liao, 'More than six hundred new families of Newtonian periodic planar collisionless three-body orbits', Science China Physics, Mechanics & Astronomy 60, 129511 (2017); arXiv:1705.00527
note: Scale-invariant periods T* = T|E|^(3/2) of the catalogued equal-mass orbits, computed here from the published 10-decimal initial conditions (the printed 3-decimal T* is kept as tstar_printed). Used only to label submissions that match a published orbit (relative tolerance 1e-6). Topologies (canonical syzygy words) were computed by integrating each published initial condition.
